offers.name: Local Visibility Jumpstart™
offers.tagline: Fix the basics that decide whether you show up on Google Maps.

customer.headline: Show up correctly where local customers look first.
customer.summary: We tighten your Google Business Profile, correct inconsistent business details across the directories that matter, fix the most obvious website friction, and set up a simple, compliant way to ask customers for reviews. Then we report what changed each month.
whatYouGet: A complete, accurate Google Business Profile with the right categories, services, hours and photos
Your name, address and phone made consistent across important listings
Quick website fixes: visible phone number, clear call-to-action, service area
A review-request link and message your team can send after every job
A plain-English monthly visibility report
customer.bestFor: Established local businesses whose profile and listings have never been properly cleaned up.

setup: Run the Google Business Profile audit and Business Entity Consistency audit; record evidence with dates.
Agree corrections list with client; apply GBP edits through delegated manager access.
Correct priority citations (major data aggregators and top directories for the industry).
Apply website conversion basics within scope (or hand a fix list to the client’s web contact).
Configure review-request link + message template; train the client on asking every customer.
Capture the baseline for monthly reporting.
monthly: Check GBP for unwanted edits, new questions and photo freshness; publish approved updates.
Prepare the monthly visibility report; route for approval before delivery.

goodFit: Has a real, staffed business location or a legitimate service area
Can grant delegated GBP manager access
Established enough to have past customers to ask for reviews
notAFit: Businesses without a legitimate address for the requested listing (no virtual offices)
Anyone asking for fake reviews, keyword-stuffed names or extra listings

notes: Share of citation/visibility tooling. Verify current vendor pricing before approval.

scopeLimits: One location and one Google Business Profile
Up to 15 citation corrections at setup
Website basics limited to up to 3 small edits on existing pages
exclusions: New website pages or redesign (see Website-to-Customer Conversion™)
Directory listing fees charged by third parties
requiredInputs: Delegated Google Business Profile manager access
Official business name, address/service area, phone, hours
List of services and service areas
Website editor access or the web contact’s details
onboarding: GBP manager access granted (no passwords shared)
reporting: Profile interactions available from GBP Insights (calls, directions, website clicks)

upgrades.when: Basics are clean and the client wants to be cited in AI answers
Review volume or recency trails local competitors
Snapshot shows weaknesses in three or more categories

offboarding: Confirm cancellation in writing and the effective date per the agreement notice period.
Deliver a final report and export of client-owned data (CSV/JSON) and documents.
Transfer or confirm client ownership of every account, profile, domain and asset created.

compliance: Follow Google Business Profile guidelines: no keyword-stuffed names, no false locations, no duplicate listings

offers.name: AI Discovery Accelerator™
offers.tagline: Make your business easy for AI assistants to understand, trust and cite.

customer.headline: Be the business AI tools can describe accurately.
customer.summary: More customers ask AI assistants for recommendations. We test how assistants describe you and your competitors using a repeatable set of prompts, fix the information they rely on, and publish clear, original answers on your site. We report what we observe each month. We never promise placement, because AI answers vary.
whatYouGet: A recorded baseline of how major AI assistants answer local questions in your category
Consistent business facts across your site, profiles and key sources
Structured data that describes your business, services and area
Original, answer-focused content written from your real expertise
Monthly sampled tracking with competitor comparison and the sources AI tools cite

monthly: Repeat the sampled prompt set under the same recorded conditions.

Prepare report noting answer variability; route for approval.
